author: TeIq
content: Delivered: GET /api/dashboard backend handler returning DashboardSnapshot DTO over 4 panels (report_volume / clusters / coordinated_signals / moderator_load). Leptos PatternDashboard page mounted at /, replacing the #10 placeholder. 4 dashboard components: report_volume_chart (hand-rolled SVG sparkline + anomaly bands shaded + ▲ glyphs, non-color-only signal, ARIA role=img + title/desc), cluster_list (drill-down to case view), coordinated_signals (kind icon + count + timestamp), moderator_load (per-category bars). 5-second LocalResource refetch for polling-based live updates. PolarisApiClient.get_dashboard extension (native + wasm). 6 backend unit tests + frontend wasm-clean build verified. ApiState gained pool field for cross-aggregate dashboard queries; cluster ranking computed in Rust over bounded result set with typed Severity enum ordering.
